# Platform RAAM

> > Platform RAAM is a Dutch academic platform focused on Russia, Eastern Europe, the Caucasus, and Central Asia, providing analysis on geopolitics, culture, and EU relations.

Platform RAAM (Russia, Eastern Europe, Caucasus, and Central Asia) is supported by Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, Universiteit Leiden, Instituut Clingendael, and other Dutch research institutions. It publishes expert analysis on Russian politics, Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova, and regional geopolitics in both Dutch and Russian languages.

- Russian politics and Putin

- Instituut Clingendael
